links.outcome: Reading level (FKRL, FRES) of simplified reports with versus without 6th-grade specification prompt
links.effect: Prompt 2 (6th-grade-level specification) reduced FKRL (p < 0.001) and increased FRES (p < 0.001), reaching the recommended patient-facing reading level.
links.quote: Prompt 2 demonstrated a reduction in FKRL (p < 0.001) and an increase in FRES (p < 0.001), demonstrating improved readability and ease of reading.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-simplified pathology reports for patients
links.effect: ChatGPT simplified reports to recommended reading level with grade-level specification while mostly maintaining accuracy (overall accuracy 3.59/4).
links.quote: ChatGPT simplified breast pathology reports to the reading level recommended for patient-facing materials when given a grade-level specification while mostly maintaining accuracy.

links.outcome: Physician-rated factual correctness, relevancy, and fabrications in AI-simplified reports
links.effect: Overall accuracy 3.59/4; factual correctness 3.62, relevancy 3.27, no fabrication 3.89 (4 = none), indicating mostly accurate output with some errors.
links.quote: To minimize the risk of medically inaccurate and/or misleading information, ChatGPT-simplified reports should be reviewed before dissemination.
